correctness.rationale: Two standalone Python 3 programs independently construct the finite order-three projective plane. The primary enumerates all 8192 subsets and a separate recursive generator with exactly 4330 faces; checks all pair/line axioms, 2145 augmented Morse pairs, 23140 oriented Hasse cover relations and complete acyclicity; computes zero 1-by-39 signed integral Morse boundary. An alternative coordinate/line generator with reverse pivot order reproduces zero attaching differential. One critical 5-cell and 39 critical 6-cells over a vertex form a wedge by Hurewicz pi5(S5)=Z. Mod-two direct ranks corroborate Betti numbers. Exhaustive 5616 projective permutations preserve lines and yield all signed Lefschetz traces by fixed-cycle unions, with sum -5616. PGL3(3) perfectness proves trivial rank-one H5 representation; finite group rational transfer proves the quotient H5=Q, H6=0. Actual checked paths: verify.py, second_check.py, verification_output.txt, second_output.txt.

value.rationale: The 13-point order-three projective plane is a canonical finite incidence structure. Its complete-line-avoiding simplicial complex is a natural Alexander-dual partner of a previously classified theta/nonblocking complex; homology duality alone leaves the integral higher cell attachments undecided. Exact null-attaching classification is a motivated complete finite homotopy theorem. The full 5616-element rational symmetry character and absence of invariant degree-six cycles provide genuinely finer structural information than homology ranks, and yield a natural quotient invariant.
